endorsements.quote: Effective integration of AI requires comprehensive training for all end-users and fostering a culture that values both technological advancements and traditional healthcare principles.

To address these challenges, a targeted communication strategy must be implemented for each stakeholder group, outlining the system’s objectives, implementation timeline, and safeguards in place to ensure human oversight and accountability.

unlisted_practices: Validate and enhance AI models using diverse, multi-site datasets and clinical trials to improve generalization.
Continually retrain and update AI models on new data and clinical advances.
Strengthen cybersecurity measures to protect patient data.
Develop clear guidelines for AI transparency and accountability.
Develop specific measurable metrics, such as time to identify CLABSI and reduction in CLABSI cases, to assess whether AI needs are met.
Involve clinicians in the development and testing phases of AI tools through training programs to build trust.
Develop standardized data pipelines and secure real-time interfaces between clinical databases and AI modules.
Conduct a documented cost-benefit analysis to justify investment in AI.

screen.reason: This is a conceptual framework paper/discussion article that outlines how healthcare systems should implement, govern, and integrate AI for CLABSI prevention and management.
